added: Your account can carry an optional **display name**: asked once after you sign in (skippable with "Not now", Escape or a click outside), changeable any time from the account menu ("Your name…"). Following the design contract (`design/CONTRACT.md` § 4–5), the home page title greets you once, "Welcome, Ana", replacing the separate "Projects" title, and the header shows just your name as the account-menu trigger; with no name set the title reads "Welcome, <your email>". The question never opens over the invitation screen. `GET /v2/me` returns it as `principal.display_name` and the new `PATCH /v2/me` (`cap.auth.me_update`, undoable) sets or clears it (at most 80 characters, no `<` `>`, control, zero-width or direction-override characters). Production promotion step 0: apply D1 migration `0016_display_name.sql` (additive nullable column; until it is applied `/v2/me` answers `display_name: null`).
fixed: Docs search: a guessed name no longer gets results when a common joining word ("feedback with inventedparam") or a repeated word ("feedback feedback inventedparam") sits beside it, and JSON Schema keywords such as "maxLength" no longer count as docs words; "list all workspaces" now ranks the workspace list first.

Docs search: every word a capability row carries still counts as a docs word except JSON Schema keyword names and types — including field names under a composed or open-ended schema ("link fragment" finds cap.survey.issue_link), roles text ("share results" finds cap.results.summary) and the other capability fields ("withdraw invitation" finds cap.grant.revoke_invitation) — so those phrases find their capabilities as they did in 0.34.10.
